tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ slob dpon rin po che padma'i rnam thar chen mo las brtsams te dri ba'i lan nges don gsal byed ces bya ba bzhugs so/ 398)gang la brten na srid pa'i 'jigs pa mtha' dag kun// nye bar zhi zhing thar pa dam pa'i 'jug ngogs su// bde blag khrid mdzad zas gtsang sras dang des gsungs chos// tshogs mchog bcas la// bdag sogs rtag tu gus pas mchod// 'dab stong padma'i snying po las/ ngo mtshar mtshan dpe'i sku mchog ni// rga nad 'chi ba'i dri bral gang*// mtsho skyes rdo rje des skyongs shig /mgon de'i rnam thar zla shel gtsang ma la// yid gnyis khyab 'jug kha rlangs mi bzad pas// sgribs na nges legs lam snang stor 'gyur bas// de slad lhag bsam 'od dkar cung zad 399)spro// gang zhig mkhas pas smras na mdzes mod kyi// blun pos smra 'di nang cha'i ltad mo ni// ston las dpyod ldan mgu ba'i yul min yang*// rmongs bdag mu cor smras 'dir mi khrel gsol/ zhes tshigs su bcad pa sngon du btang nas/ de yang shes bya'i gnas la mkhyen pa'i spyan yangs pa'i bla ma rme ru ba de nyid kyis/ padma bka' yi thang yig las brtsams te dogs slong 'ga' zhig gnang ba la lan gyi rnam pa rang nyid kyis ji ltar go tshod tsam zhig 'bul bar bya ba las thog mar dri yig de'i dbur/ sngon rgya gar 400)rdo rje gdan na rdo rje gdan pa che chung gsum byon pa'i snga ma paṇa chen a shwa ka shrīs gser srang lnga brgya'i rin thang gi cha rkyen gyis dur khrod chen po bsil ba tshal du tshogs kyi 'khor lo bshams pa na/ grub chen brgyad cu rtsa lnga dus gcig la dngos su byon pa rnams la tshogs kyis mchod cing bstod pa shwo lo ka re phul bas/ grub thob rnams kyis kyang rdo rje'i mgur re re gnang bar mdzad skabs kyi gu ru padma'i bstod pa de 'di skabs lung 'dren gnang 'dug rung phyag dpe ma dag pa gcig gzigs pa 'dra ste/

ji skad du/ dge slong lus la phyag rgyar bcas// lho nub srin po'i kha gnon mdzad// pra wa ka ra zhes bya ba'i// bla ma de la phyag 'tshal lo/ zhes bkod pa gnang 'dug pa 'di la/ pra wa ka ra zhes pa ma lags te/ padma ka ra zhes dgos rgyur snang zhing*/ de yang padma ni rgya bod mthun par legs 401)sbyar sor bzhag dang*/ 'byung gnas kyi skad dod ā ka ra dang padma'i ma gnyis mtshams sbyor byas pas padma ka ra zhes su 'grub pa de yin pa dang*/ dri ba'i 'bru don dngos kyi le tshan dang por/ slob dpon 'di nyid mngal skyes dang brdzus skyes su 'dod pa'i phyogs gnyis dang*/ rab tu byung ba'i mtshan padma 'byung gnas dang*// gsang mtshan padma sam bha wa dang*/ rab byung gi mtshan shākya seng ger 'dod pa phyogs gnyis dang*/ zhes gsungs snang ba 'di la lan du ci zhu na/ slob dpon rin po che 'di nyid spyi khyab yongs grags su ni brdzus skyes nyid dang*/ de yang brdzus skyes yin pa gcig pu la ni ngo mtshar ci che ste/ skye 'gro rnams skye gnas bzhi gang rung las ma 'das mod kyang*/ slob dpon 'di ni 'od dpag med sogs phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba kun gyi thugs rje'i 'od zer gcig tu bsdus te dha na ko ṣa'i mtsho 402)dbus su pad sdong la thim nas 'khrungs pa yin tshe khyad par du 'phags pa dang*/ de yang rnying ma ba'i rmongs rgan dag gis sdug zhen gyis bstod pa byas pa lta bu ma lags te/ sangs rgyas nyid kyis mdo rgyud kun tu lung bstan par mdzad la/ lung nyid kyang rnying lugs rang gi rgyud sde'i lung brjod rung gzhan dag thugs yid ches pa dka' bas na/ lha mo dri ma med pa'i mdo las/ phyogs dus rgyal ba ma lus kun// phrin las gcig tu bsdus pa yi// ngo mtshar mchog brnyes rgyal ba'i sras// phrin las 'dus pa'i bdag nyid ni/ o rgyan gandho'i nub byang 'byung*/ zhes pa dang*/ gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab 'i mdo las/

bskal bzang mdzad pa rmad byung gi /dus gsum rgyal ba'i rnam 'phrul ni// ngo mtshar padma'i snying po la// rig pa 'dzin pa der snang ngo*/ zhes dang*/ gtum po las rgya mtsho'i rgyud las/ 403)sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang ba 'dzin// rdo rje khro bo las kyi rgyal// o rgyan ko sha'i mtsho gling du// yab med yum bral sprul pa'i sku// rig pa 'dzin par snang bar 'gyur/ zhes sogs lung brjod las 'das mod kyang 'di tsam gyis go bar 'gyur bas mang du ma spros shing*/ 'gag don la padma las brdzus te 'khrungs par bstan pa nyid don la gnas shing*/ yang brdzus skyes kyis gdul yul du gyur par mngal skyes kyi tshul gyis 'dul dgos pa'i gdul bya dag gi snang ngor mngal skyes su bstan par yang mdzad de/ o rgyan yul gyi rgyal po ma nu sī ta zhes pa'i sras su 'khrungs nas/ da na rakṣi ta zhes mtshan du thogs pa de cher skyes nas chos la gshegs par bzhed kyang yab yum gyis ma btang zhing thabs gzhan gang gis kyang chos la mi thar zhing rgyal khrims dang 'gal ba'i drag 404)spyod kyis thar bar dgongs nas rgyal po'i phru gu zhig bkums pas khrims kyi/chad par mtha' la sprugs pa dang*/ mkhan po shākya bho dhi las rab tu byung bas shākya seng ger mtshan thogs tshul sogs yod mod kyi/ mdor na/ slob dpon 'di ni gang zag so skye rang rgyud pa ma yin pas/ mdzad pa rnam thar thams cad sprul pa gang la gang 'dul du bstan pa yin tshul blo khog tu chud dgos kyi/ tha mal rang rgyud par bzung bas ni rgyal ba'i yon tan gyi rnam par mthong ba'i skal ba gzhar yang mi 'byung ba nyid do/ ༈ mtshan gyis bye brag de dag kyang*/ thog mar pad sdong las 'khrungs par ma zad/ int+ra bhu tis gdan drangs pa'i shul lam na gar bzhag bzhag tu pad sdong skyes pa byung tshe/ khye'u 'di ni padma'i 'byung gnas nyid du 'dug go zhes gleng pas/

padma ka ra zhes/ padma 'byung gnas su grags la/ 405)rab tu byung ba'i mtshan ni shākya seṅge dang*/ phyis za hor gyi yul sogs su rig pa'i gnas la ma rmongs shing paṇa chen lnga brgya'i tshogs dpon mdzad tshe/ padma sam bha wa zhes grags pa de ni bod skad du padma las skyes zhes/ 'khrungs pa la brten nas mtshan der grags pa yin mod lags/ dri don gnyis par/ slob dpon de nyid bod du byon nas lo brgya dang nyi shur bzhugs pa'i lo rgyus dang*/ yang*/ bdud blon gyi phra ma dbang btsan pas gshegs par zhus pa'i rkyen gyis bod yul du lo drug tsam dang*/ lo gsum dang*/ zla ba bco brgyad dang*/ zla ba gsum las ma bzhugs pa'i tshul sogs 'chad tshul mi mthun pa sna tshogs 'dug par/ 'di 'thad 'di mi 'thad kyi dpyad pa nged rang gis ga la nus/ ༈ zhes gsungs 'dug pa shin tu thugs mad de/ 'di dag gi skabs tshor yang gong 406)du brjod pa ltar rgyal ba rnams kyi mdzad pa la so so skye bos tshad bzung bar mi nus pa'i tshul ni 'dir yang dran dgos la/ ji ltar sngon ston pa nyid kyis dam chos pad dkar gsungs pa'i yun snga dro gcig la bar bskal lnga bcu'i yun du snang ba'i rdzu 'phrul mdzad pa'i lo rgyus bzhin/ skad cig ma la bskal pa dang*/ bskal pa la yang skad cig mar byin gyis rlob pa dag rang cag gi blo yul du ga la 'gyur/ spyi mthun gyi snang ngor yang*/ slob dpon bod du byon nas bsam yas kyi sa 'dul dang*/ lha srin 'dul ba'i sbyin sreg lan gnyis mdzad nas lan gsum pa yang sdig blon sogs kyis mdzad du ma ster ba dang*/ rgyal po dang skal ldan 'ga' zhig la gdams pa kha yar gnang*/ bod kyi bye thang thams cad ne thang dang*/ gram khrod kun zhing du bsgyur/ chu shing dkon 407)par de rnams 'byung bar bya ba sogs mdzad rgyu thams cad kyang blon po rnams kyi log rtog gis bkag pa sogs kyis dgongs pa ma rdzogs bzhin du rgyal pos phul ba'i dngos po rnams las gser phye spar ba gang ma gtogs ma bsnams par/

gung thang la kha bar du chos blon gnyis kyis zhabs skyel zhus nas gshegs tshul dang*/ lam bar du yang bdud blon rnams kyis gshed ma btang nas sku dkrongs rtsis la gshed ma rengs pa'i lta stangs kyi btul zhing*/ gung thang la thog nas nam mkha' la 'phur te lho nub tu gshegs tshul sogs kyi lo rgyus de dag sba bzhed rgyas bsdus rnams kyi 'chad tshul kho na yin zhing*/ sba bzhed rnams ni rgyal blon gyis bsgrigs pa'i kun rdzob ltar snang 'ba' zhig yin pas/ nges dag tu ni mi bzhed la/ ji ltar thub pa chen 408)po nyid kyi mdzad pa bcu gnyis sogs kyang theg chen theg dman gnyis kyi lugs tha dad pa la yang nges pa kho na ni theg chen lugs la byed kyi/ theg dman lugs ni gdul bya rang gi skal bas de tsam las ma mthong ba ste/ dper na dung dkar zhig la mkhris nad yod med gnyis kyis mthong tshul tha dad kyang mkhris nad med pas mthong ba nyid don la gnas pa ltar/ 'dir yang ma dag pa'i snang ba la bden par mi bzung bar/ slob dpon nyid kyi gsung lhad med dag la yid brtan du bya dgos phyir/ gter chos lhad med kyi lo rgyus rnams su ji ltar byung ba la blo 'gel ba lags shing*/ de dag mthun par slob dpon nyid bod yul du lo brgya dang bcu gcig bzhugs par gsungs pa kho na dang*/ 'on kyang lo de ni 'phags yul du zla ba drug lo ru 'dren pa'i srol gyis/ 'di skabs kyang phyed 409)lor brtsis te bod lugs ltar na lo lnga bcu rtsa drug bzhugs pa nyid du bshad cing*/ gong gi sba bzhed ltar zla ba 'ga' zhig bzhugs nas phar gshegs tshul bstan pa de yang bdud blon sogs bod 'bangs ma dad pa rnams kyi ngor de ltar bstan nas slob dpon nyid bsam yas kyi sa 'dul rab gnas dang*/ rje 'bangs skal ldan dag rjes su 'dzin pa'i skabs ma gtogs/ phal cher ni bod kyi gnas chen dang yul khams mtha' dag zhabs kyis bcags shing byin gyis rlob pa dang zab gter sbed pa sogs kho na mdzad pas dus 'da' bas bod 'bangs phal gyis ma mjal bar snang la/

mthar lho nub srin yul du 'byon khar ni chos 'khor gtsug lag rnams la rab gnas bskyar zhing*/ mang yul gung thang la thog gi bar du lha sras sogs bod 'bangs zhabs skyel 410)ba kun dang lhan cig byon nas lung byang zhal gdams gnang*/ gung thang la khar sprel zla'i tshes bcu la dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams kyis mchod sprin dang bcas te nam mkha'i lam la gdan drangs nas rnga yab gling du gshegs pa de nyid nges dag tu bzhed pa lags/ dri ba gsum pa la/ padma bka' thang gi le'u dang po'i skabs las brtsams te gnang 'dug pa/ de yang*/ nub bde ba can gyi zhing de na 'byung ba nam mkha'i ming mi grags na thams cad thogs bcas su yod dgos par thal ba dang*/ padma las brdzus te skye dgos pa la/ skye zhing 'chi ba'i ming yang mi grags ces pa'i 'gal skyon dang*/ snying rje dang smon lam gyi dbang gis 'chi tshul dang*/ dus kyis 'chi ba yang yod dam snyam gsungs ba dang*/ zhing khams de na 'phags pa min pa gzhan mi gnas pa dang*/ sangs rgyas nyag gcig gi zhing yin pa sogs bshad tshul 'di dag 411)blo la babs po ma byung gsung ba 'di dag ni bla ma nyid spyir yang bka' mdo rgyud kyi mkhyen pa mnga' ba zhig ni los yin la/ khyad par bka' 'gyur khrod kyi bde ba can gyi zhing bkod kyi mdo sogs la thugs rtog chud pa ni gzhir bcas lhag par bka' thang le'u dang po'i skor de ni chos rgyal srong btsan gyi bka' chems ding sang ma ṇi bka' 'bum zhes yongs grags 'di ka'i lo rgyus kyi dbu na yod pa de dang tshig don khyad med kho na yin tshe rnying lugs kyi 'chad sgros la thugs yid ma ches na'ang srong btsan bka' 'bum la thugs ma ches pa ga la srid kyang*/ 'di dag ni bdag cag rnying hrul ba rnams la tshod lta'i phyir gsungs pa las 'os ma mchis rung*/ bdag rmongs rgan gyis go tshul tsam zhig 'bul bar bgyi na/ de yang*/ zhing der nam mkha' med na thams cad gdos bcas su thal

412)gsung ba la/ spyir rigs lnga'i zhing khams shar mngon dga'/ lho dpal ldan/ nub bde can/ byang las rab grub pa/ dbus stug po bkod pa sogs la drang nges kyi dbye bas/ rang snang longs sku'i zhing dang*/ thugs rje sprul pa'i zhing gnyis su bshad pa'i/ longs sku'i zhing ni dug lnga dbyings su dag pas ye shes lnga mngon du gyur zhing sku lnga lhun gyis grub pa'i 'bras bu ye shes rang snang dag pa'i zhing yin phyir sa bcu'i byang sems dang rim gnyis mthar phyin dag gi ngo la snang ba las gzhan pa'i spyod yul du ma gyur mod la/ thugs rje sprul pa'i zhing 'di dag ni zhing ni rgyal ba'i thugs rje dang gdul bya'i skal ba rten 'brel 'dzom pa'i nus mthu las grub cing*/ don dam par snang srid 'khor 'das thams cad sangs rgyas sku gsum gyi zhing khams su ma gyur pa ni 'ga' yang ma mchis mod/ des na/ chos dbyings khyab gdal las/ 413)gzhan pa'i nam mkha'i ming mi grag par bshad pa ni nam mkha' sogs phyi'i 'byung ba lnga dang sha khrag drod dbugs sogs nang gi khams dang skye mched thams cad ming tsam brda tsam btags pa tsam dang*/ nam mkha' zhes ming du btags pa la brten nas nyi zla gza' skar dang sprin dang char dang na bun khu rlangs sogs sna tshogs su snang ba thams cad kun rdzob rten cing 'brel 'byung tsam du snang ba ste/ rgyud bla mar sa ni chu la chu rlung la/ zhes sogs nas/ sems kyi rang bzhin chos rnams ni// thams cad la yang gnas ma yin/ zhes pa'i bar du gsungs pa ltar lags mod kyi/ rang bzhin sprul pa'i zhing de dag tu ni nam mkha' sogs 'byung lnga mtshan bcas su grub pa ga la yod de/ ci'i phyir na/ mtshan mar 'dzin mkhan gyi 'khrul rtog med pa'i phyir ro/ 'o na/ dpag bsam gyi shing dang padma'i rdzing 414)bu chos kyi sgra snyan 'byin pa'i bya tshogs sogs de dag ci yin snyam na/ de thams cad ye shes thugs rje'i sprul pa las gzhan ma yin no/

yang*/ skye 'chi'i ming mi grag pa dang padma las brdzus te skye ba 'gal gsung ba/ zhing 'dir ma dag las nyon gyi 'khrul 'khor skye 'chi 'khor ba'i 'byung 'jug yod na dag pa'i zhig gi mtshan nyid du ga la 'gro ste/ thugs rje chen po'i gsungs pa'i bde chen smon lam las/ zhing mchog de na ngan song sems can dang*// lha dang mi dang gshin rje'i ming yang med// des na phal ba'i bud med yod ma yin// mngal na gnas pa'ang bud med yod pa ma yin no// rin chen rnams kyi me tog padma las// brdzus te 'khrungs pa'i rang bzhin sha stag go zhes sogs dang*/ zhing der gnas pa'i sems can thams cad la// na tsha la sogs sdug bsngal gtan mi 'byung*/ zhes sogs rgya cher gsungs pas na/ 415)las ngan gyi skye sgo dang dbang med dus min du 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa sogs dang bral ba kho na lags/ yang*/ zhing der 'phags pa min pa gzhan mi gnas pa dang*/ sangs rgyas nyag gcig gi zhing yin par bshad pa sogs thugs la ma shong mi dgos te/ las nyon gyi sgrib gnyis bag chags sogs ma byang ma dag pa dang*/ tshogs gnyis smon lam gyi 'bras bu ma smin pa dag gis ni zhing khams de dag mthong bar ga la nus shing*/ rdzogs min sbyang gsum mthar phyin pa dag la 'phags pa'am sangs rgyas kyi ming brjod pa thugs la ma shong rgyu ci yod/ 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po bzang po mchog tu sprul pa de khengs sems che ba dag 'dul ba'i phyir yin par bshad 'dug pa/ zhing der nyon mong med pa dang khengs pa'am nga rgyal can yod pa 'gal gsungs pa dang*/ yang*/ rgyal 416)po bzang po mchog de gling bzazhar dbang bsgyur yin na/ bde ba can dang sgra mi snyan sogs kyang 'brel mtshungs su ma mthong gsung ba la/ ༈ bka' thang nyid du/ sangs rgyas 'od dpag med pas khams kyi rgyal po la sogs dregs pa'am khengs sems kyis bcings pa rnams 'dul phyir dbu'i gtsug nas 'od zer spros pa las rgyal po bzang po mchog sprul bar bshad pa ma gtogs/

bde ba can der nga rgyal khengs sems kyis bcings pa yod par gsungs pa ma lags/ gling bzhir mnga' mdzad de yang*/ rgyal ba sku gsum gyi gdul zhing 'jig rten gyi khams 'byams klas phyogs bcu dus bzhir chags gnas 'jig stong gi bkod pa rgyun mi chad pas na/ rgyal po bzang po mchog byon pa'i skabs kyi gling bzhi de da lta 'o skol gyi ston pa'i gdul zhing gi gling bzhi 'di dag 417)yin pa'i nges pa ci zhig yod de/ zhing khams gcig gi rdul phra rab re la'ang grangs med kyi zhing khams yod gsungs na/ de dag ye shes spyan ldan gyis gzigs yul ma gtogs/ 'o skol byis blo rnams kyis tshad ci la 'dzin te/ bzang po mchog gi sprul pa yin phyir sprul pa'i mdzad pa so skyes rtogs mi nus so/ ༈ dri ba lnga pa/ shākya thub pa tshe lo brgyad cu bar byon par 'dod pa dang*/ dus gsum sangs rgyas mngal sgo 'grim par bshad pa dang*/ ka tyā ya ṇa ston pa'i nye gnas su bshad pa rnams ni yi ge ma dag pa yin nam snyam/ gsung snang ba/ shāka thub dgung lo brgyad cur bzhugs par bshad pa las/ tshe lo brgyad cu par bshad pa ni rnying lugs kyi yig cha gang la'ang ma mthong zhing*/ ka tyā ya ṇa ston pa'i nye gnas dngos mdzad rabs kyang ma thos la/ 'on kyang*/ skabs 418)'ga' rer nye gnas kyi ming gis brjod pa tsam yod srid kyang 'gal cher mi 'byung mod/ dus gsum sangs rgyas mngal sgo 'grim/ grangs med gsum du bsod nams bsags/ zhes/ rgyal po khri srong gi phyag la 'gyings skabs su gsungs pa'i mgur de la thugs ma rangs pa yin shas che yang*/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas rnams thog ma med pa'i sngon rol nas mngon par byang chub kyang thun mong gdul bya'i ngor 'jig rten gyi khams su 'gro ba rnams pa sna tshogs su skye ba'i tshul ston zhing grangs med kyi bskal par tshogs bsags sgrib sbyong gi mdzad pa ston pa dang*/

dag pa dang ma dag pa'i mngal sgo 'grim tshul ston pa 'di sangs rgyas spyi'i chos tshul yin phyir 'o skol gyi ston pa'i skyes rabs rnams su gsal ba ni dgongs par mnga' mod la 'di skabs kyi sger don du slob dpon padma nyid sangs rgyas su 419)zhal gyis bzhes pa'i tshig sgros de thugs la ma 'thad pa yin mchi ste/ slob dpon de'i gdul byar gtogs pa rnams ni rgyal bas mdo rgyud du mar slob dpon de nyid sangs rgyas rnams kyi thugs rje gcig bsdus yin par gsungs pa tshad mar 'dzin pa lags tshe skyabs gnas ma nor ba'i khul yin la/ sku nyid lta bu la slob dpon padma sangs rgyas yin pa'i sdug yus u tshugs ci la byed lta bu lags/ ༈ bar 'dir bka' thang gi 'phros shig tu/ byams sogs tshad med bzhi la nang bses lnga tshan du dbye tshul de ni skabs thob dbang gis gang ltar 'dren yod pa ni cha ma 'tshal te/ ji ltar chos spyi las phar phyin drug dang bcu sogs 'dren pa la/ mdo bskal bzang las phar phyin brgya nyi shur gsungs pa sogs 'di rigs bka' 'gyur la gom 420)'dris che ba dag las gzhan gyi mtha' chod pa dka' bar mchis lags/ dri ba drug pa/ dbus 'gyur lung bstan gyi mdo dang bla med don rdzogs 'dus pa'i rgyud kyi lung drangs pa ltar na/ sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'das nas lo brgyad la o rgyan 'khrungs par lung bstan pa bzhin yin pa'i dbang du byas na rgyal sar lo lnga dang*/ bsil ba tshal du lo lnga ste bcu song nas kun dga' bo'i drung du byon nas bsnyen par rdzogs pa mdzad pa'i lo rgyus sogs na 'dul ba khas mi len na ma gtogs lo grangs ma tshang par bsnyen rdzogs mdzad mi srid dam snyam/ zhes gsungs pa la/ spyir slob dpon nyid 'byon par lung bstan pa'i lo grangs mi 'dra ba yang yod de/ nga ni mya ngan 'das 'og tu// lo ni bzhi gnyis lon pa na/ zhes lo brgyad na 'byon par lung bstan tshul 'gal yang snang mod kyi/

gzhan 421)phal cher mthun pa ni lo bcu gnyis kho na yin te/ myang 'das kyi mdor/ nga ni mya ngan 'das 'og tu/ lo ni bcu gnyis lon pa'i tshe// o rgyan yul gyi nub byang mtshams// dri med ko sha'i mtsho gling du// ge sar padma'i snying po las// kun las lhag pa'i skyes bu 'byung*/ zhes sogs dang*/ dbus 'gyur lung bstan gyi mdor/ rtag lta bsun 'byin nga ni mya ngan 'da'// chad lta bsun 'byin bzhi gsum bcu gnyis na// ko sha'i mtsho gling dri med padma las// rgyal po'i thugs dgyes sras kyi dam par 'gyur// bla med snying po don gyi chos 'khor bskor/ zhes gsungs pa de kho na'i dbang du byas pa'i gter chos lhad med kyi lo rgyus thams cad gung mthun par 'dug cing*/ spyir ston pa nyid kyi sku bltams dus dang mya ngan las 'das dus sogs kyi lo dag ngos 'dzin 422)tshul bka' bstan bcos so sor mi mthun pa mang na'ang*/ rnying lugs kyi lo rgyus phal mo cher/ thub dbang nyid me bya la mya ngan las 'das pa dang de rjes kyi sa sprel la slob dpon 'khrungs par bshad pa 'ba' shig snang bas na/ bar der lo bcu gnyis gsungs pa nyid don la gnas sam snyam lags/ bka' thang nas 'phags pa kun dga' bo la rab byung mdzad par 'chad pa dang*/ dgra bcom nyi ma'i gung pa dang lhan cig 'dzom tshul dang*/ dbu skra bsil mkhan yang 'od srungs bgres pos mdzad sgros dang*/ de skabs kun dga' bo la mdo'i lo rgyus sogs dris lan mdzad tshul gyi skor de dag thams cad ni gter chos khungs thub lhad med kyi lo rgyus gzhan gang la yang med ces gsar rnying gi mkhas grub mang pos gsungs par thos la/ rmongs rgan bdag 'dra bas 423)kyang slob dpon gyi rnam thar rgyas bsdus du ma zhig mthong zhing*/ khyad par rnam thar zangs gling mar grags pa mnga' bdag myang gi gter ma'i shog ser dngos la zhib par brtag gzhib bgyis pa yin kyang*/

sku rab tu byung ba'i dus kyang rgyal srid lo lnga dang bsil ba tshal du lo lnga bzhugs nas slar dur khrod dga' ba'i tshal dang so sa gling sogs mang por bzhugs nas mkha' 'gro rdo rje phag mo dang zhi ba mtsho/ bdud 'dul ma sogs ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis dbang bskur zhing byin gyis rlabs/ las dang 'jig rten gyi mkha' 'gro thams cad dam la btags shing bran du bkol bar mdzad pa dang*/ chos thams cad dang shes bya'i gnas mtha' dag dgongs pa'i klong nas shar yang*/ thun mong gi gdul bya yid ches bskyed phyir yig rigs rtsis sman sgra tshad bzo rigs sogs mtha' dag la bslab sbyang mdzad pa'i tshul 424)bstan/ de rjes za hor ṇḍa'i brag phug tu mkhan po shākya bo dhi'am yongs grags kyi mtshan du slob dpon chen po pra ha sti las rab byung bzhes nas shākya seng ger mtshan gsol zhing*/ dbu skra bsil bas gtsug tor gsal bar gyur pa de skye bo tha mal pa rnams kyi blor mi shong ba'i log rtog dgag phyir ngur smrig gi dbu zhwa mdzad tshul dang*/ slar yang dge slong shākya mi tra rnam gnyis dang bcas pa'i shākya rnam gsum la pra bha ha stis rnal 'byor yo ga'i dbang bskur dang rgyud 'grel man ngag gnang nas gsan tshul sogs kyi lo rgyus rnams ni rtsod med nges 'drongs lags shing*/ spyir/ gsang sngags snga 'gyur gyi chos rnams zab rgyas rmad du byung yang gang zag phal cher chos la nyams len dang rtog 'jug mi byed par gnas skabs za chog dang las mtha' phran tshegs la mgo 'khor ba dang*/ khyim pa'i 425)spyod pa la gnas te mdo sngags gang gi yang phyogs la mi nye ba sha stag tu gyur pas snga 'gyur gyi bstan pa'i zhabs drangs/ de'i skyon gyis gsar ma'i gang zag mkhas blun mtha' dag pas rnying ma'i chos dang gang zag gnyis ka la sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i gral khyur 'jug pa lta zhog ngan skyug gi phung po mthong ba ltar ya ga 'dogs pa'i gnas su byed pa 'di bzhin gyur mod la/

de ltar gyur pa'i rgyu rkyen ni/ sangs rgyas gnyis pa padma 'byung gnas kyi gsung rab dri ma med pa rnams la rang bzo'i bcos bsgyur bsre bslad 'phri bsnan dbang za tshod yod sogs kyis gsang sngags dmar bshas su byed pa mang pos gser phye chu la 'pho ba dang tsan dan sol bar btsongs pa'i dpe bzhin gyur pa dang*/ ding sang snyigs ma'i dus 'dir yang gter rnying lhad med rnams la 'chad nyan nyams len byed mkhan med par 426)glegs bam 'bu srin gyi tshang du gyur bzhin par/ gter gsar gter min gter 'dra mang po spang la sha mo brdol pa bzhin dar nas skye bo blun dad can mang po phung du 'jug pa'i tshul la bdag 'dra rmongs pa'i ban rgan yang mchi ma khong du 'bab pa las gzhan pa'i thabs kyis dben par gyur lags/ zhes gnas tshul gyi 'phros don gsol nas/ skabs don snying por ci zhu na/ deng sang yongs grags kyi padma bka' thang o rgyan gling pa dang sangs rgyas gling pa gnyis kyi gter ma yin par grags pa tshig bcad lhug pa gnyis kyis bod khams khyab pa'i phrin las ni 'dug la/ dngos gzhi ni slob dpon gyi gsung yin par gor ma chags kyang*/ bar mtshams dag tu gang zag rmongs blun spyi rtol can dag gis grong tshig dang rang bzo'i bsre bslad mang po zhig byas par nges la/ 'di dang mtshungs 427)par bka' thang sde lngar grags pa de yang o rgyan gling pa'i gter ma 'khrul med yin rgyu bar byed snang yang*/ tshig don gang la brtags kyang gter chos tshad ldan dang lar mi 'dra zhing*/ slob dpon rin po che la sras 'khrungs pa dang*/ de chos la blo mi 'gro ba byung rabs dang*/ yang ni slob dpon dpal dbyangs gu ru'i sras yin par bshad pa sogs lung du mi srid pa'i gtam rgyud mang po dang*/ skor thu shes rab sogs dus phyi mo'i gang zag dag gis lo rgyus sogs cha mi mtshungs pa mang po 'dug pas bdag sogs ni nges 'drongs ma byung zhing*/

de ltar padma bka' thang la yang slob dpon gyi gsung mang po 'dres pas byin rlabs ni los yod kyang*/ lo rgyus khungs thub dpang por 'jog nyan pa ni dka' ba tsam dang*/ de'i phyir kun dga' bo'i skor gyi lo rgyus de dag la zhib cha'i lan 428)'bul dgos par ma gyur/ lar babs nas/ slob dpon nyid de skabs mkhas grub thams cad la gsan pa mdzad pas na kun dga' bo dang mjal zhing sde snod gsan yod pa ni yin srid kyang lo rgyus khungs ma gzhan la cher ma mthong*/ 'od srungs kyis bstan pa 'dzin skabs yin na sdom pa yang de la gsan par mdzad thang zhing*/ kun dga' bor bstan pa gtad nas ni 'od srungs mya ngan las 'das tshar bas dbu skra bsil mkhan mdzad don yang ma mchis pa dang*/ de bzhin du nyi ma'i gung pa'i skabs don kyang ma mtshungs thabs shig ma mchis shing*/ spyir ni sangs rgyas dang skyes chen grub thob kyi mdzad pa la so skyes tshad bzung du ga la nus te/ dus byin gyis rlabs pa dang*/ sku'i bkod pa du ma dang*/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rnam 'gyur bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i phyir dang*/ la lar ni rgyal ba'i gsung dang 429)mdzad pa gcig la gdul bya so so dbang po dang skal ba'i khyad kyis tha dad du mthong ba ste/ dper na cho 'phrul chen po bstan pa yang theg dman gyi ngor nyin zhag gcig la theg chen gyi ngor zla ba phyed du byung ba dang*/ thun mong gi snang ngor bka' 'khor lo gsum las med par mthong yang*/ thun min gyi ngor phal chen dang dus 'khor sogs mtha' yas pa gsungs tshul sogs 'byung bas na/ nam du yang chos mig yang dag ma thob ring la chos dang gang zag gi tshad bzung du mi rung ba ni dgongs mnga' ltar dang*/ theg chen theg dman gyi khyad par yang shin tu che tshul dper na/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal rgyal po gsal rgyal gyi btsun mo'i 'khor gyi nang du dbyar gnas mdzad pa'i rjes su 'od srungs chen pos/ sems dpa' ltung ba can khyod dge 'dun

430)gyi nang du ma 'dug cig ces gnas dbyung gi gaṇḍi brdungs ba na/ ston pa nyid kyis kyang 'jam dpal la rang gi yon tan gyi mthu ston zhig par bkas gnang ba ltar 'jam dpal gyis mthus/ phyogs bcu'i zhing ji snyed par ston pa re re'i drung na 'jam dpal re re dang*/ gnas dbyung gi gaṇḍi brdung ba'i 'od srungs re re 'dug par mthong zhing*/ bcom ldan 'das kyis 'od srungs khyod 'jam dpal 'di thams cad skrod dam gcig 'di kho na skrod ces dri ba mdzad pas 'od srungs 'gyod de gaṇḍi 'dor bar 'dod kyang 'dor ma nus shing sgra yang ma chad pas/ ston pa la bzod par gsol ba na 'jam dpal nyid la bzod gsol gyis shig gsungs pa'i lo rgyus ltar/ zag bral gyi dgra bcom chen po 'od srungs lta bus kyang gzhan gyi rgyud tshod ma mkhyen na rang cag so skyes ga la shes pas na sgrib pa mi gsog pa ni shin tu gces pa lags/ dper na gong gi 'phror/ 431)kun dga' bo la dris par bshad pa'i 'dul ba'i skor la ni bka' dngos dang phyis kyi bstan bcos 'dres mar bgrangs pas rang mtshang bstan pa de kar zad cing dper na/ mgo sha 'dul ba'i mdo zhes pa de yang*/ dbyangs kyi skad dod gho ṣa zhes pa de ma shes pa'i blun rtags su snang ste/ gang ltar blun pos lhad bcug pa la dpyad kyis ga la langs te/ log pa'i lam la mtha' med phyir/ de dag 'dir ni spro bya min/ zhes gsungs pa nyid dang*/ chos kyi phung po'i tshad 'dzin lugs mi 'dra ba du ma snang ba de dag kyang thun mong theg pa'i dbang tsam du byas pa las/ sngags kyi rgyud sde rab 'byams lta bu'i tshad su zhig gis 'dzin par nus la bka' thang gi der/ sangs rgyas kyi gsungs mtha' dag yi ger btabs pas glang chen rab brtan gyi rgyab khal lnga brgya byung bar bshad pa 432)de yang na mang yang na nyung bar gda' bas slob dpon gyi gsung min par go la/ lar yang*/

bka' rnams yi ger btabs dus kyang bsdu ba gsum pa man la yin tshul thun mong ba ni gsar rnying bzhed pa mthun zhing/ khyad par ba 'ga' zhig gi sger don la ni ma nges te/ lha'i dbang pos sher phyin dang rgyal mtshan dpung rgyan sogs glegs bam byas tshul dang*/ khyim bdag mgo reg shi ba'i yo byad gang yod thams cad dge 'dun la phul skabs/ ston pa nyid kyis bka' bstsal te/ phyi rol pa'i glegs bam rnams ni btsong du rung la nga'i bka' ni 'tshong bar mi rung ngo zhes/ dkon mchog gi dkor glud za ba dgag par mdzad tshul la dpags kyang de dus nas bka'i glegs bam yod par mngon zhing*/ ma skyes dgra'i sras u pa zhes bya bas kyang rgyal ba'i bka' rnams glegs bam du bzhengs tshul sogs 433)mang mod/ bka' thams cad gter du bzhugs par bshad pa de yang*/ gdul bya'i yul tha dad so sor dad rten gyi tshul du bzhugs pa ma gtogs/ rnying lugs kyi gter kha rnams kyi sbed tshul lta bu ni min par snang la/ ji skad du/ mdo sde bzhag par byas zhes pas/ gter gton tha dad re dgos pa lta bu ma lags pa dang*/ lar yang*/ bka' yin no cog ni bod tsam du ma zad rgya gar nyid du bzhugs med par snang ste/ dper mtshon na/ sher phyin 'bum pa la yang rim pa gsum yod pa'i rgyas shos la shwo lo ka bye ba phrag brgya yod pa de dri za'i yul du bzhugs/ 'bring po 'bum phrag brgya pa ni sum cu rtsa gsum na lha dbang gi mchod gnas dang*/ bsdus shos 'bum yod pa ding sang dar ba 'di yang zhabs cung zhig ma tshang ba klu yul du lus pa/ de bzhin du mdo sde phal cher la bod du 'gyur 434)ba rnams dum bu tsam yin par gsungs mod/ mngon pa gong 'og gsum du 'dren tshul gang yin gsung ba de ni/ mngon pa dang po ni bka' rnams dang*/ bar pa ni dgra bcom pa rnams kyis mdzad pa dang*/ phyi ma ni dbyig gnyen sku mched sogs kyis mdzad pa ding sang yongs grags rnams la ngos 'dzin pa'i 'dren tshul zhig snang*/

mngon pa la dgra lan gsum zhes ba'i tha snyad gang yin gsung ba/ de las dang po ni/ nang pa'i dge 'dun bsdu ba'i gaṇḍi'i sgra las/ mu stegs rtog ge rnams kyi klad pa 'gems/ zhes pa'i skad de la ko long byas te mu stegs pa'i dmag drangs nas nang pa'i gtsug lag glegs bam sogs mang po bsreg pa dang*/ bar pa ni/ yul dbus kyi rgyal pos mu stegs rgyal po la gos rin thang med pa skyes su bskur ba la/ snying ga'i thad du rkang rjes 'dra ba'i mtshan 435)ma mthong bas ngan sngags byas par 'dug ces log lta skyes nas dmag drangs te gtsug lag thams cad bcom/ phyi ma ni/ mu stegs pa'i sprang po gnyis bza' btung slong du 'ongs pa la/ nang pa'i thab g.yog dag gis chu tshan 'thor ba sogs brnyas pa byas pa'i zhe nad kyis/ mig nyi mar bsgrub pa'i ngan sngags kyis nang pa'i lha khang gsung rab sogs bsregs nas mngon pa'i bstan pa nub la thug par gyur pa'i tshe/ dge slong ma gsal ba'i tshul khrims kyis bstan pa gso bar smon lam btab ste thogs med sku mched bskyed par mdzad pa de lags/ yang nyid kyis/ mngon par sde snod ngos 'dzin gyi skabs su/ 'jam dpal dbyangs la 'gyur phyag 'tshal ba thams cad mngon par ngos 'dzin pa yin gsung ba de ni nges pa can du ma mthong la spyi khyab tu ni 436)tshul khrims kyi bslab pa gtso bor ston pa rnams 'dul ba'i sde snod/ ting 'dzin bslab pa gtso bor ston pa mdo sde/ shes rab bslab pa gtso bor ston pa ma mo mngon pa'i sde snod du gsungs pa dang*/ de'i nang mtshan la yang 'dul ba'i 'dul ba/ 'dul ba'i mdo sde/ 'dul ba'i mngon pa/ mdo sde'i 'dul ba/ mdo sde'i mdo sde/ mdo sde'i mngon pa/ mngon pa'i 'dul ba/ mngon pa'i mdo sde/ mngon pa'i mngon pa dang bcas pa'i sde tshan yod par bshad mod kyi/ mdor bsdu na/ de gsum gsang sngags ltar spyod pa ston pa 'dul ba/

sgom pa ston pa mdo sde lta ba ston pa mngon pa yin phyir/ gnas skabs su chos tshan sdebs lugs kyi khyad tsam ma gtogs/ mthar thug gi don la rgyal ba thabs mkhas shing thugs rje che ba'i yon tan gyis/ de gsum re 437)res kyang gdul bya'i gang zag gi rgyud sbyong 'dul/ smin par byas nas bla na med pa'i byang chub la dkri bar mdzad tshul khyad par ma mchis pas na/ dam pa'i chos ni thog mar dge ba/ bar du dge ba/ mtha' mar dge ba zhes pa kho na'i don lags tshe/ 'o skol so skyes mgo rlung 'khrugs 'khrugs tu dbye ba 'byed mi dgos sam snyam pa blun tshod dang sngon gyi mkhas grub shing rta'i srol 'byed rnams kyis dbye ba mdzad pa de kas chog tshe/ rang cag rjes 'jug rnams rgyud thog tu nyams su blang kho na gal che bar go lags/ dri ba bdun pa ni/ bka' thang gi za hor gyi skabs su/ lha lcam mandha ra ba khyim thabs la 'gro ma nyan pa la yab rgyal po thugs ma dgyes par lha lcam g.yog mo lnga brgya'i dkyil du bcug nas 438)pho brang nang nas phyir mi gtong zhing gal te lcebs sam 'gros na g.yog mo lnga brgya gson por khyis zar 'jug go zhes byas rabs dang*/ yang rgyal po'i gsol skum ma rnyed pas lha lcam gcig pu sha nyo bar btang pa'i lo rgyus sogs 'go 'jug ma mtshungs pa dang*/ za hor rgyal khams thams cad la dbang bsgyur zhing btsun mo lnga brgya dang*/ phyi blon nang blon bdun rgya nyi shu yod par bshad nas skrum sha ma rnyed pa mi srid cing g.yog 'khor de tsam yod na lha lcam gces pa de gcig pu sha nyo bar gtong mi srid na 'di dag ji ltar yin zhes gsung ba la/ spyir rgya gar gyi rgyal po chen po rnams pho brang nang du longs spyod 'byor pa los yod kyang*/ nub re mos kyis btsun mo so so'i khyim du zhag mal sdod srol dang*/ bzhes pa yang de kar 'dren pa yin pas skrum sha

439)la thogs pa'ang srid pa dang*/ de skabs lha lcam g.yog mo lnga brgya'i nang du ma bcur bar ma'i khyim du bzhugs skabs yin snang tshe rgya ri nyo ba gzhan gtong ba blos ma khel bas lha lcam nyid btang tshul ni spyi don ltar bur snang la sbas don/ bram ze skye ba bdun pa'i sku sha de las 'phro skal bar ldan pa'i gang zag ma gtogs phal gyis mi rnyed pas na skabs der rgyal po las dang skal bar ldan pa dang lha lcam ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma yin pa'i gnad kyis skye bdun gyi sha gdan drangs ba'i rten 'brel gyi mtshams sbyor de bzhin byung ba las/ dus nam byung du de ltar ga nas mdzad de/ dgos pa can gyi skabs don du gda' lags/ dri ba brgyad pa/ slob dpon nyid la lha lcam gyis/ bdag gi yab 'di skye ba gang lags zhus pa la/ bram ze'i 440)bur skyes shing rab byung byas pa la gtsug lag bsrung ba'i slad du mu stegs kyi dmag mang po bsad pa las/ gtsug lag bsrungs pa'i dge ba dang dmag bsad pa'i sdig las 'dres ma'i las kyis 'gro ba drug ka'i skye ba blangs tshul gsungs 'dug rung*/ 'khor ba thog med nas rigs drug tu skyes pa'i grangs sangs rgyas kyis kyang mi mkhyen par bshad pa la/ khyed cag sems can sar skyes yod par bshad 'dug pa 'khor ba la thog mtha' yod par khas len nam gsung snang ba/ 'di skabs rgyal po gtsug lag 'dzin 'gro ba drug kar skyes tshul gsungs pa de 'khor ba thog med kyi skyes rabs gsungs pa ma lags te/ bram ze'i bu der skyes pa tshun chad kyi ragis drug tu skyes tshul gsungs par snang*/ spyir sems can gsar skyes yod med bdag la mngon shes mi ldan tshe zhu rgyu 441)ga la mchis pas/ gsar skyes yod par gsung mkhan dang gleng mo mdzad par zhu/ 'khor ba thog med kyi skye ba'i grangs gzhan gyis ga la shes kyang*/ sangs rgyas kyis mi mkhyen na ni sangs rgyas thams cad mkhyen pa ma yin par mi 'gyur ram/

bdag cag ni 'khor ba la thog mtha' yod par khas mi len la/ 'on kyang*/ sems can spyi tshan la de ltar yin kyang gang zag sgos tshan la thog ma med kyang mtha' ma ni lam nyams su blangs nas grol ba thob pa'i gang zag de slar 'khor bar 'khyams par mi 'dod pa lags/ ༈ dri ba dgu par/ slob dpon nyid dur khrod bde chen gdal du bzhugs pa'i skabs kyi mi ltogs kyi ba dang bon po'i mkhar rnga stor ba'i gtam brgyud der/ bon po blos byas kyi grub mtha' bod du gsar byung las 'phags yul du bon po yod pa'i sgros gsung rab 442)gar yang mi snang*/ zhes gsungs pa la/ mi ltogs dang bon po gnyis kyi lo rgyus 'di yang bka' thang ma gtogs rnying ma'i lo rgyus gzhan la ni ma mthong zhing*/ bka' thang la lhad 'dres tshul ni gong nas zhus pa de ltar lags shing*/ lar rgya gar na bon po'i ming thogs pa zhig med par thams cad kyis cha 'jog mod kyang*/ bon po'i byung khungs ni zhang zhung yin la/ zhang zhung dang kha che'i yul khad nye ba'i stabs las dang por med kyang phyis dar yod pa yang ma nges la/ de bzhin du bal yul na bon po yod pa'i sgros spyi la ma grags na'ang*/ mkhas pa g.yu thog mgon po de nyid bal por bon dang rdzu 'phrul 'gran dgos par byung tshe nam mkha' la rdo rje skyil krung du nyin phyed bar du bzhugs pa'i lo rgyus kyang yod phyir/ rgya gar sogs su yang med pa'i nges pa rang mi byung 443)bar sems la/ spyir bon 'di bod du gsar byung yin gsung ba de ni/ bod 'dir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa ma byung gi bar yan chad thams cad du bon gyis bzung 'dug pa dang*/ de'i byung khungs ston pa gshen rab ni zhang zhung du 'ol mo lung ring zhes par 'khrungs shing sku tshad mi phal pa'i bcu drug pa/ pags pa gser mdog las gzhan pa'i mtshan dpe thams cad tshang bar byung nas/ kong yul gyi bon ri chen po'i phyogs bzhir sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa bcu gnyis dang cha 'dra bar bstan pa'i zhabs rjes khru gang pa mang po dang*/

mda' chu khron pa skyes sogs kyang yod 'dug pa dang*/ bon la phyi nang gnyis kyi phyi pa ni deng sang gi grong bon snang gshan pa 'jig rten pa'i lha 'dre mchod mkhan 'di dag yin phyir/ nang pa'i skyabs sdom skabs kyi spang bya de ka yin pas 444)sngon bod yul du 'di dag rgya gar du mu stegs pas byed pa ji lta bar sha ba dang g.yag lug sogs gsod pa'i cho ga de dag mkhan slob chos gsum gyi dus su bsnub par mdzad/ 'jig rten rnam rtog sel byed tsam du srog chags de dag zan dang 'jim pa sogs la bzo ba'i srol 'di bzhin dang*/ rgyu 'bras kyi bon dngos ni nang pa'i mdo sngags kyi lta grub skyon med yin tshul mang po zhig snang rung*/ gsar ma'i chos rgyud phal cher gyis bon dang*/ rnying ma ba zhes gnyis ka sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i khrod du mi 'dzud par snang tshe/ rgyu mtshan mang po brjod rung rang nyid yi ge'i ngal ba dang snag shog gron pa tsam las spros pa'i dgos don ma mchis lags/ dri ba bcu pa/ sangs rgyas 'jig rten na byon tshe me tog u dum wa ra 'byung bar bshad skabs/ rgyal rigs su 'khrungs 445)na me tog dkar po dang*/ bram zer 'khrungs na dmar po/ rje rigs la ser po/ dmangs rigs la mthing ga skye bar bshad pa dang*/ o rgyan nyid bram ze'i rigs yin pas me tog dmar po yin par bshad 'dug pa/ bka' bstan bcos tshad ldan las ni sangs rgyas rnams rgyal rigs dang bram ze'i rigs gnyis gang rung las ma gtogs rigs gzhan las 'khrungs par ma bshad pas na khyed kyi lugs 'di la lung khungs dgos par 'dug gsung ba/ rnying ma ba la ma grags pa'i lo rgyus 'di 'dra khyed la gsung rgyu snang ba/ 'di dag mngon mkhyen bzhin yin nam yang na mnal lam dag snang lta bur rnga yab gling du slob dpon gyi drung du gsan pa lta bu zhig lags sam bdag cag rnying hrul ba tsho'i lo rgyus ltar na sangs rgyas mchog gi sprul sku ni rgyal rigs dang*/

bram ze'i rigs gnyis kho na las byung 446)ba dang*/ 'jig rten na sangs rgyas 'byung ba yang rab tu dkon pa'i brda mtshon du me tog u dum wa ra yang rgyal ba 'khrungs pa dang dus mtshungs par shar zhing*/ mya ngan las 'das bar nye tshe rnyings par 'gyur ba'i tshul ni gsar rnying bzhed pa mthun la/ kun tu rgyu rab bzang gi gtam brgyud las kyang go mod de la ni me tog kha dog gi dbye ba ma bshad mod kyi/ skad dod kyi dbang du byas na u dum wa ra bsgyur na dmar mchog ces 'gyur ba la dpags na ni dmar po 'ong dgos par snang ba dang*/ o rgyan rin po che rdzus skyes la bram ze'i rigs su sus smra/ rnying ma'i lo rgyus dag tu dha na ko sha'i mtsho gling du u dum wa ra skye bar ni bshad na'ang*/ gu ru rin po che sku 'khrungs sa de u dum wa ra yin pa'i nges gsal med cing*/ mtsho der padma kha dog sna tshogs par bshad kyang*/ 447)sku 'khrungs sa de dmar po rang yin pa'i gsal kha yang med pa dang*/ khyad par slob dpon bram ze'i rigs yin pas me tog dmar po yod par bshad pa sogs ni sku nyid ma gtogs gzhan sus kyang gsung bar ma thos/ rnying ma'i lo rgyus las gter gton nam byung me tog u dum wa ra bshad pa dang*/ rigs tha dad las me tog kha dog gi dbye ba bshad pa sogs ni 'dug pa 'di la'ang phyis kyi gsar ma'i mkhas pa la las dgag par mdzad de/ 'jig rten khams na sangs rgyas ma gtogs gzhan gter gton re tsam la u dum wa ra skye dgos na nyan rang byang sems dang skyes chen dam pa gzhan thams cad la cis mi skye ste/ 'di dag kyang rnying ma ba rnams kyi zog gtam 'ba' zhig tu snang gsungs mod kyang*/ rnying ma'i gter gton rnams skyes chen gang las kyang*/ 448)lhag pas u dum wa ra ma skye ba yin zer ba ma lags te/ gter gton tshad ldan de dag gis gter nas spyan drangs pa'i zab chos de rnams rdo rje theg pa'i smin grol gyi gdams pa'i yang snying tshe gcig sangs rgyas kyi zab chos de dag gis skal ldan mang po 'khor ba mtha' can du byed pas sangs rgyas 'jig rten na byon pa dang mtshungs pa'i brda rtags su u dum wa ra 'byung ba dang*/

de nyid kyang gter gton 'khrungs pa'am yul gang byung du skye bar bshad pa ma yin te dha na ko sha'i mtsho gling sogs su skye zhing*/ de ltar skyes pa dang yang tha mal pa'i gang zag phal gyis ga la rtogs te/ 'jig rten skyong ba'i lha klu dang dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos srung rnams kyis rig nas zab mo'i chos de dag gi mthun rkyen dang phrin las sgrub par byed pa lags/ ༈ dri ba bcu gcig pa/ o rgyan gyi gsung du 449)nga ni ming gi sangs rgyas ma yin te// dge sbyong 'bras bu bzhi thob sangs rgyas yin/ zhes pa'i tshig don la thugs ma rangs pas dgag pa mang du mdzad snang ba la/ spyir bka' thang la lhad 'dres par ni snyan du gsol bzhin pa dang*/ o rgyan nyid nyan thos dgra bcom pa'i 'bras bu sger du mngon gyur mdzad mi mdzad ni bdag 'dras khas len mi 'bul la/ rnying ma rang lugs la ni slob dpon chen po 'di phyogs dus kyi rgyal ba ma lus pa'i thugs rje gcig tu bsdus te snyigs dus kyi 'gro ba 'dul ba'i sprul pa'i skur byon pa yin par thag gcod pa dang*/ de yang rang 'dod rmongs zhen u tshugs kyi sgo nas ma yin te/ ston pa nyid kyi lung bstan pa yin tshe de las spros pa'i nyan rang gi 'bras bu 450)mngon du mdzad ma mdzad sogs so skye lam rim bgrod kyi brtsi bzhag byed med lags/ ༈ dri ba bcu gnyis pa/ gang chung gis ni lha yi me tog brkus// lha yi 'dul khrims rnam par dag pa nyams/ zhes pa 'di ni lha la 'dul khrims med pa la yod par 'ol tshod byas par gda' zhing*/ mi dge spong ba tsam la 'dul khrims su byas na ha cang thal che gsungs 'dug pa 'di ni/ mkhan slob chos gsum po gdul bya thun mong pa'i snang ngor sngon gyi 'khrungs rabs dang smon lam btab tshul gyi lo rgyus skor de yin snang ba/ 'di la spyir mi dge spong ba la 'dul khrims mi bzhed na nyes spyod sdom pa'i tshul khrims de gang la ngos 'dzin pa lags/

lha rnams la so thar gyi bslab pa yongs rdzogs med na'ang 451)brgya byin ni byang chub sems dpa' lha rnams kyi ded dpon du bzhugs pa yin te/ tshangs pa brgya byin gnyis bskal bzang rgyal ba stong gi zhabs 'bring du gyur pas na/ rang gi gdul bya rnams lam log las skyob pa'i bslab bya dang dge ba'i las lam ston par mi mdzad dam/ rnying lugs las ni 'gro drug gi gnas su thub pa drug gis 'gro don mdzad tshul yod na'ang*/ sku nyid sogs kyi dgongs par 'bab dka' tshe snyan du gsol mi 'tshal la/ gzhan yang gnas brtan chen po lam bstan 'khor dgra bcom dgu brgya dang bcas pa yang sum cu rtsa gsum du shākya'i bstan pa skyong phyir bzhugs na/ lha rnams la lam dang lam ma yin pa ston pa'i thugs rje'i phrin las ye mi mdzad dam lags/ ༈ dri ba bcu gsum pa la/ slob dpon nyid sangs rgyas las khyad chos 452)lnga'i sgo nas 'phags par bshad pa la thugs ma rangs pa ni sku nyid gcig pur ma zad gsar ma'i mkhas pa phal che bas de ltar gsungs te/ 'jig rten khams na sangs rgyas la 'gran gyi do med dang de las lhag pa nam yang mi srid pa la/ rnying ma ba rnams ham pa dang spobs pa nan tar ches 'dug dgongs pa mgrin gcig dbyangs gcig tu mdzad mod kyi/ de ni spyir rnying hrul ba gog po rnams khas dma' bas bka' bkyon mdzad bde ba tsam ma gtogs/ gzhan ni ji skad du/ sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku// rdo rje 'dzin pa'i ngo bo nyid/ sogs dang*/ bla ma sangs rgyas bla ma chos// de bzhin bla ma dge 'dun te// kun gyi byed po bla ma yin/ zhes sogs dang*/ bskal pa stong gi sangs rgyas kyang*// bla ma dag la brten nas byung*/ zhes sogs kyi lung mtha' 453)yas mod kyang*/ khyed mkhyen rgya can la nged gtir rgan gyis phar lung 'dren byas kyang rang nyid yi ge'i las su che ba tsam du zad la/ 'gag don du/ rnying ma ba rnams o rgyan rin po che la dad mos byed pa las ches lhag pa tsam chos rgyud gzhan rnams rang rang gi bstan pa'i bdag po dang bla mar dad mthong mdzad bzhin pa la/

rnying ma bas o rgyan la mthong byar mi rung ba ni ma lags grang*/ sangs rgyas las khyad chos lngas lhag tshul de dag kyang rgyal ba nyid kyis gsungs pa las/ rnying ma ba'i bcos pa ma yin te/ de yang myang 'das kyi mdo las/ kye ho/ 'khor rnams rtse gcig yid kyis nyon// nga yi sprul pa de nyid ni// dus gsum sprul pa gzhan las 'phags// bgres rgud mi mnga' gzhon nu'i tshul// sku mchog sprul pa 454)gzhan las 'phags// bdud bzhi thog med nyid nas bcom// drag rtsal sprul pa gzhan las 'phags// tshe gcig sangs rgyas theg chen ston// dgongs pa sprul pa gzhan las 'phags// 'dzam gling mtha' dbus kun 'dul te// 'gro don sprul pa gzhan las 'phags// skal bzang 'di la 'das grongs med// sku tshe sprul pa gzhan las 'phags// ci phyir 'od dpag med nyid do/ zhes gsungs la/ skabs 'dir sku nyid dpe ma dag pa zhig gzigs pa yin nam bad rlung gi bsnyun gyis dbu 'khor ba min las che ste/ tshe gcig sangs rgyas theg chen ston/ zhes pa/ gu ru tshe gcig sangs rgyas yin zer bar dgongs pa la 'char yod snang yang de ni ma lags te/ slob dpon 'di tshe gcig lus gcig la sangs rgya ba'i gdams pa gsang sngags zab mo ston 455)mkhan yin pas khyad par du 'phags tshul gsungs par gda' zhing*/ yang nyid kyis/ slob dpon nyid sangs rgyas las kyang tshe gcig gis sangs rgyas yin pas lhag pa'i sgrub byed du/ mgon po 'od mi 'gyur ba tshe dpag tu med pa dngos yin pa'i phyir ro/ zhes bshad 'dug pa 'di nyid 'brel yod pa ma go zhing*/ tshe dpag med dngos yin pas sprul pa'i sku'i gzhan las lhag pa bsgrub mi nus te/ dge slong chos kyi 'byung gnas lam rim gyis sbyangs pa tshe gcig sangs rgyas su mi 'gro zhes pa sogs dgag pa rgyas par gnang 'dug kyang*/ dngos gzhi khyed rang nyid kyis kyang mgon po 'od mi 'gyur ba dang tshe dpag med kyi dbye ba ma mkhyen 'dug pa dang*/

tshe dpag med pa yang gang zag phal pa lam rim bgrod kyi sangs rgyas yin par dgongs yod snang ba 456)dag snang gi spyan 'phangs de cung dma' par mi 'gyur ram lags/ rnying lugs la ni mgon po 'od mi 'gyur pa zhes pa de ni dus gsum gyi rgyal ba ma lus pa thams cad kyi thugs ye shes khyab gdal chen po gzod nas 'khrul ma myong ba'i gdod ma'i gnas lugs spros pa'i mtha' las 'das pa mchog tu mi 'gyur bde ba chen po chos kyi sku kun tu bzang po 'od mi 'gyur ba sangs rgyas thams cad kyi spyi mes chen po zhes pa la bzhed pa yin zhing*/ de nyid kyi rang gdangs 'gag pa med pa ye shes sgrib bral gyi skur snang ba drug pa rdo rje 'chang dang rgyal ba longs spyod rdzogs pa rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas sogs sa bcu'i sems dpa' chen po dag gi ngor snang ba'i kha sbyor longs sku yan lag bdun ldan dang de dag gi thugs rje'i sgyu 'phrul mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i rnam rol las bzo dang skye dang byang 457)chub mchog gi sprul pa'i sku sogs ji srid gdul bya'i khams nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa de srid sprul pa'i zlos gar rgyun mi chad du 'byung ba'i phyir/ phyogs bcu rab 'byams kyi rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor thams cad dang*/ mi mjed kyi zhing 'dir yang bskal bzang gi sangs rgyas stong gi 'phreng ba rim par byon pa de thams cad thugs ye shes chos kyi dbyings chen por ro gcig pa las/ gnas skabs gdul bya'i skal snod yul dus gang la gang 'tshams shing de la des 'dul ba'i sprul pa'i sgyu 'phrul bstan tshul 'bab shig tu 'dod pa ma gtogs/ sangs rgyas de rnams gang zag so skye phal pa zhig lam rim pas sbyang bgrod kho na byas te sangs rgyas pa yin par mi 'dod la/ 'o na mdo sde mtha' dag nas gsungs pa'i dang por byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed/ bar du grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags

458)mthar mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi sgo nas sangs rgyas par gsungs pa 'di dag ci yin zhe na/ 'di dag thams cad thun mong gi gdul bya rnams la 'di lta bu byas na 'di ltar 'byung ngo zhes brda ston pa'i drang don gyi phrin las kho na yin pas na/ dper na 'o skol gyi ston pa shākya'i dbang po gcig pu la mtshon na ye thog dang po'i sangs rgyas chos kyi sku kun tu bzang po phyogs bcu'i zhing khams brtan g.yo 'khor 'das ma lus pa'i khyab bdag chen por gyur phyir snod bcud snang srid kyi zhing khams thams cad du sprul pa skus khyab pa sku dang zhing khams su snang ba de dag kyang gsang gsum mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lor rdzogs pa'i ye shes kyi rang mdangs rnam par snang mdzad gangs chen mtsho dang*/ thugs rje sprul pa'i sku mchog shākya'i dbang por sprul pas theg pa che chung gi gdul bya tha dad pa'i skal ba 459)dang mthun pa'i don mdzad pa ste/ ji skad du chos kyi sku las ma g.yos par// sprul pa'i rang bzhin sna tshogs kyi// skye ba mngon par skye ba dang*// dga' ldan gnas nas 'pho ba dang*/ zhes sogs mdzad pa bcu gnyis mthar phyin par bstan tshul 'di bzhin sangs rgyas thams cad la mtshungs tshul gyi lung mtha' yas yod na'ang*/ khyed dge ba'i bshes gnyen la bdag cag gti thug rnams kyis lung 'dren dgos par yang ma gyur la/ mi rgan yi ge'i ngal ba yang mi theg pas ma spros lags shing*/ de'i phyir padma 'byung gnas kyang rgyal ba thub pa'i dbang po sogs sangs rgyas rnams kyis snyigs dus kyi sems can 'dul phyir sprul pa'i zla snang gdul bya'i dad mtshor snang tsam la mngal skyes dang brdzus skyes la rtsod pa dang*/ dgra bcom 'bras bu thob ma thob dang*/ tshe 460)gcig sangs rgyas yin ma yin sogs kyi dgag sgrub ji tsam byas rung byis pa nam mkha'i mtha' rgya la brtsod pa ltar 'gyur la/ bka' thang lhad can sogs kyi tshig don la a 'thas pa'i dgag pa po dang sgrub pa po gnyis ka ngal ba don med du zad cing*/

yid brtan gyi snying por bya rgyu ni/ rgyal ba'i gsung rab las/ drang don la mi rton nges don rton dgos pa dang*/ chos can la mi rton chos nyid la rton pa dang*/ tshig la mi rton don la rton dgos par gsungs pa nyid gal che ba lags mod/ ༈ dri ba bcu bzhi pa/ gu ru padma rgyal po skyed mos tshal du gshegs pa na rgyal po chen po bzhis zhabs 'bring bgyis nas gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong ldan pa sogs rgyal srid rin po che bdun gyis sna drangs shing lha klus mchod pa byas tshul de dag mi bden tshul dang*/ ci'i phyir na/ de dag ni 461)'khor los bsgyur ba'i yon tan gyi 'byor pa yin phyir rtsod ldan la 'khor bsgyur mi 'byung bas na*/ de dag kyang blun po dag gis mi mtshungs pa'i bstod ra byas par snang gsungs pa la/ spyir bskal pa rtsod ldan la 'khor bsgyur mi 'byung ba dang bye brag tu padma 'byung gnas gsang sngags kyi ston par byon pa las 'khor bsgyur gyi rgyal por byon pa ma yin tshe thugs bden mod kyi/ 'di ni rgyal ba sras bcas sprul pa'i gang zag mchog rnams la 'jig rten skyong ba'i lha klu sogs kyis mchod pa'i bkod pa khyad par 'phags pa sna tshogs pas bskur bstir bgyid pa'i rnam 'gyur yin phyir/ phyis kyi gang zag skyes chen dag sku 'khrungs pa dang 'das dang grub pa brnyes pa dang chos kyi sbyin pa sogs mdzad pa'i tshe 'ja' 'od kyi gur dang me tog gi char 'byung ba sogs 462)kyang 'jig rten skyong ba'i dkar phyogs lha klu dpa' bo mkha' 'gro sogs kyi 'du ba dang mchod pa'i bkod 'phrul yin na'ang*/ 'o skol chu bur gyi mig can rnams kyis ni lha klu sogs de dag mi mthong ba las 'os ci zhig skabs don gzhan yang yod de/ sangs rgyas rnams gdul bya 'dul thabs kyi rnam grangs la lar 'khor bsgyur gyi tshul ltar ston pa yang 'byung ba ni sngon grong khyer bu ram shing 'phel du ma ga dha bzang mos ston pa 'khor bcas spyan drangs pa'i tshe rdzu 'phrul gyi bkod pa mi 'dra ba tha dad pas gshegs pa na/

'phags pa sgra gcan 'dzin ni 'khor lo bsgyur ba'i rgyal po'i cha byad kyis byon par mdzad pa yang yod mod/ yang*/ rtsod ldan la 'khor bsgyur mi 'byung bas rgyal srid sna bdun gyi mchod pa yang 'bul mi rung na/ da lta chos rgyud thams cad kyis maṇḍal 463)'bul ba na rgyal srid bdun po 'bul ba mi 'gab pa lags bsam dgongs mdzod/ ༈ dri ba bco lnga pa/ slob dpon rgyal srid spangs nas gshegs pa'i thog mar/ rgya gar bka' skyong brag phug tu rdo rje dbyings kyi sgrub pa zhag bdun mdzad nas thob par bshad nas/ slar/ pra hasti'i drung du rnal 'byor yo ga'i chos zhus pas/ dbang ma bskur bar gsang sngags 'chad snod min/ gsungs te gzhi nas dbang zhus par bshad na gong du sgrub pa mdzad pa de su la zhus pa dang*/ yang bsil ba tshal sogs su sgrub pa mdzad nas dngos grub brnyes na/ slar yang ma ra ti kar tshe'i rig 'dzin bsgrub ci dgos te/ mdor na 'di 'dra ba mi mtshungs pa lo rgyus mang po snang gsungs ba de la gu ru nyid gang zag tha mal pa ma yin tshul yang yang gsol ba 'dir yang 464)dran dgos la/ thog mar dha na ko shar pad sdong las sku bltams pa na 'jig rten khams kyi lha ma srin sde brgyad kun gyis phyag mchod phul zhing*/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba thams cad mkha' la sprin phung bstibs pa bzhin byon nas dbang bskur zhing byin gyis brlabs pa des dbang gi go chod las che zhing*/ bka' skyong brag phug tu zhag bdun la grub pa thob pa de thugs la ma shong na*/ rgya bod kyi skyes chen mang po'i rnam thar na de lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab mod cing*/ slob dpon sprul pa'i sku la lta ci smos te/ deng sang gsar rnying gi gang zag phal mo ches yi dam so so'i bsnyen sgrub zhag gsum bdun nyer gcig sogs la grub pa'i mtshan ma byung ba dag kyang lha de 'grub pa'i rtags kyi bye brag ma lags sam/ pra bha ha sti dbang ma bskur bar gsang sngags 'chad mi rung bar gsungs pa yang slob dpon kho na la ma yin te/

465)dge slong shākya rnam gnyis kyang yod mod/ de skabs rnal 'byor yo ga'i rgyud 'grel gsan tshul bstan pa tsam du ma zad/ dur khrod chen po brgyad du bzhugs pa'i bar skabs du mar/ 'og min chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang sogs su/ kun bzang rdor 'chang rdor sems sogs sku gsum ston pa rnams dang dga' rab 'jam dpal shrī sing dang mkha' 'gro las kyi dbang chen sogs la gsang sngags yo ga rnam gsum gyi chos mtha' dag la sgro 'dogs bcad pas na/ rnal 'byor rgyud kyi yo ga kho na tsam ma yin no/ ma ra ti kar tshe'i sgrub pa mdzad pa de yang gu ru nyid skyes 'chis 'jigs nas tshe sgrub mdzad dgos byung ba ma lags kyang*/ phyi rabs kyi gdul bya rnams la phan pa'i phyir tshe'i sgrub pa mdzad tshul gyis mgon po tshe dpag med dngos la tshe'i rgyud sgrub thabs man ngag zhus nas sku nyid gcig pur ma zad 466)lha lcam mandha ra yang 'chi med kyi sku grub pa'i mthus ma gcig grub pa'i rgyal mor grags shing snod ldan mang po rjes su bzung ba'i bka' drin las deng sang gsar ma la tshe sgrub grub rgyal ma zhes rlung ltar grags pa'i 'gro phan ji tsam yod/ gzhan yang*/ grub pa thob tshar nas tshe sgrub byed ga la dgos snyam du thugs la dgongs 'dug pa gsang sngags rnying lugs kyi skabs 'dir rig pa 'dzin pa'i go 'phang la yang rnam grangs tha dad yod de/ phyag rgya chen po'i rig 'dzin/ tshe la dbang ba'i rig 'dzin/ lhun gyis grub pa'i rig 'dzin/ rnam par smin pa'i rig 'dzin sogs tha dad sgrub tu yod mod kyang*/ rnying lugs kyi chos skad zur pa ru song tshe snyan du 'jug pa zhig yong shas chung bas skabs 'dir ma spros so/ dri ba bcu drug pa/ shākya thub pas rgya nag yul du gshegs te dge sdig rgyu 'bras kyi chos gsung 467)pas su yang nyan med cing skur pa btabs pa la thugs mug ste bya rgod spungs rir byon par bshad pa dang*/

o rgyan nyid bya rgod spungs ri nas gdul bya'i zhing khams gar 'dug gzigs pas me long la gzugs brnyan shar ba bzhin gsal por gzigs par bshad pa 'di yang sangs rgyas las o rgyan lhag par 'dod pa dang*/ sangs rgyas nyid gdul bya'i yul mi mkhyen pa'am thugs rje'i nus pa zad par bshad pa lta bus sangs rgyas la brnyas pa che gsungs pa 'di thad la/ o rgyan gdul bya'i yul dus los mkhyen mod kyang*/ sangs rgyas gdul bya'i yul dus mi mkhyen pa ni mu stegs pa las gzhan su zhig smra ste/ 'dul ba'i dus ma yin pa'ang de ltar mkhyen pa'i dbang gis/ zab zhi spros bral 'od gsal 'dus ma byas/ zhes sogs gsungs pa'i dus dang*/ dge sbyong rnams 468)bag med pa'i spyod pa las bzlog phyir 'bar ba'i phug tu sku mtshams gcod par bstan pa'i tshul sogs 'byung mod la/ spyir yang rgyal ba'i thugs rjes ma khyab pa dang mi gzigs pa zhig ga la mchis kyang*/ sku dngos kyi gdul ba'i yul du gyur ma gyur gyi gnad las/ bod yul spyan ras gzigs kyi gdul zhing du bka' bstsal zhing byin gyis brlabs pa ltar/ rgya nag 'dul ba la 'phags pa 'jam dpal bsngags pa ma gtogs/ thub pa nyid rgya nag tu sku dngos kyis byon pa'i lo rgyus bka' bstan bcos gang nas kyang ma byung phyir/ bka' thang gi 'chad tshul 'di yang gu ru rin po che'i gsung dngos yin par dogs so/ ༈ dri ba bcu bdun pa/ chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan gyi slob dpon gdan drangs dus dang bsam yas bzhengs dus sogs kyi 'phros pa zhib rgyas gnang zhing*/ 'gag don snying por 469)rgyal po dgung lo lnga bcu rtsa drug la 'das nas lo skor gyi bar du gsang zhing slob dpon gyis rgyal srid mdzad par bshad pa don la gnas mi gnas dang*/ lha sras kyi dus su slob dpon bzhugs yun ring thung*/ skar chung rdor dbyings lha khang bzhengs dus slob dpon gyi rab gnas mdzad ma mdzad dang*/

ston min rtsen min gyi rtsod pa byung skabs slob dpon ci mdzad sogs kyi dri ba gnang ba dri tshig mthar chags bkod na 'brel chags pa 'ong na'ang*/ mi rgan mig med long 'gros kyi bri dgos phyir yig tshogs chung ba la dmigs nas don 'gag bsdus tsam las 'bul bar ma lcogs pas/ ci zhu na/ 'di dag gi skor la rgyal rabs chos 'byung sogs spyi la grags pa'i rigs ni ha cang mi mthun pa mang nas gang gi lugs la yid brtan byed pa ma shes/ bka' thang nyid 470)nas gsungs pa dag kyang lhad can lhad med 'byed dka' tshe blo 'khel gyi gnas dkon la/ 'on kyang rnying lugs gter chos lhad med dag gi lo rgyus kyi dbang du bgyis na/ khri srong lde'u btsan rta lor 'khrungs pa'i bcu bdun lo la chos kyi bsam pa thugs la 'khrungs nas mkhan po zhi ba 'tsho spyan drangs nas gtsug lag rmangs bting yang lha 'dre gdug pa can gyis bar chad byas pa la/ mkhan pos lung bstan pa bzhin slob dpon spyan drangs nas stag lo'i mjug tu phebs shing sa 'dul mdzad de yos lor rmangs bting nas lo lnga la 'byongs shing rab gnas mdzad pa'i dga' ston lo skor gyi bar byas pa dang*/ slob dpon nyid bsam yas dang mchims phu bsdoms par lo bcu tsam bzhugs pa'i ring la chos bsgyur ba dang*/ snod ldan smin grol mdzad la/ 471)gzhan ni bod yul gyi sgrub gnas rnams su bzhugs pa shas che bar bshad de/ rtsod pa byung dus slob dpon de skabs mi bzhugs/ ston rtsen gyi bstan pa'i sel 'byung ba yang mkhan pos lung bstan zhing de'i 'dul skal ka ma la shī la yin pas de gdan drongs shig gsungs ba ltar ka ma la shī las hā shang btul nas bstan pa'i srol sngar bzhin tshugs/ rgyal po sku tshe nyi zla ltar thub par mdzad rgyu'i dbang dang tshe chu bsgrubs nas gnang khar sdig blon gyis bkag pas rten 'brel ma 'grig rgyal po slar 'gyod nas tshe bsring bar zhus pas tshe dbang gis lo bcu gsum bsrings nas/

tshe tshad nga drug las med pa la drug cu rtsa dgu thub nas gshegs/ sras gsum gyi che ba mu ne btsan po rgyal sar bkod nas sde snod gsum mngon byang dang bcas pa'i mchod chen 472)bzhi btsugs shing rgyal khams dbul phyug bsnyoms pa sogs mdzad pa ya mtshan kyang yum gdug rtsub ches pas dug gis bkrongs/ sras bar pa mu tig btsad po'am/ mu khri btsan po/ hu rtse btsan po sogs mtshan gyi rnam grangs dang*/ slob dpon gyis legs pa'i blo gros zhes btags pa de sku gzhon pas rgyal por rung mi rung mod/ nyams sad na legs pa 'dra zhes bgros pa dang*/ dbu 'gying stabs su bzhugs pa la btags te/ sad na legs 'jing yon zhes grags pa lo bcu gsum pa de rgyal sar bkod nas skar chung dgu thog rdor dbyings kyi lha khang bzhengs pa dang*/ de'i btsun mo ngang tshul mas yar klung btsan thang gis gtsug lag khang bzhengs pa rnams la slob dpon gyis rab gnas mdzad/ sras tha chung mu rub btsad po'am/ lha sras dge mgon thugs gtum pas yum gyis spur po bya thul mgon 473)btags shing*/ slob dpon nyid kyi lha sras dam 'dzin zhes 'dogs par mdzad pa de nyid dpa' rtsal che bas mtha' bzhi'i dgra 'dul ba'i dmag dpon la byon nas thams cad mnga' 'og tu bcug pa'i mthar blon po'i bu bkum pa'i chad par kong rong gi yul du lo dgu spyugs pa'i dbang gis mchims kyi gad pa skya bo dang*/ nyang khrid bad kyi do bo 'di la deng sang se mo rgyal rir grags pa dang gnyis su sku mkhar dang gtsug lag bzhengs pas/ sku skye ba phyi ma sangs rgyas gling pa'i gdan sa'i rten 'brel 'grig kong rong du lo dgu 'khor rjes yar byon pa/ sna nam pa rnams kyis sngar gyi zhe nad kyis chibs dkrogs pas brdabs te 'das/ mu tig btsan po na gzhon zhing slob dpon la dad pa che bas bya byed 'dun stabs mtha' dag zhal ta zhus pa la brten slob dpon gyis rgyal srid

474)bzung bar sgro btags pa las gzhan ga la mdzad de/ lha sras de'i skabs lo gsum tsam gyi ring la slob dpon bzhugs nas 'jing yon gyi sras lnga'i che shos rgyal sras lha rje la zhal gdams lung bstan gnang ba de dang*/ sras lhun grub gnyis ka sku na phra mo la gshegs/ lha sras gtsang ma rab tu byung ba dang glang dar rgyal por ma 'os pas khri ral pa can rgyal sar bkos tshul sogs ni lo rgyus phal cher mthun mod kyi/ gang ltar lha sras mu tig dgung lo gzhon nu nas slob dpon lho nub tu gshegs pa nyid lags/ dri ba bco brgyad pa/ slob dpon dang rgyal po yon mchod kyi gsung gleng gi skabs/ ya thog ring mo ma thog ring mo dang*/ zhes pa de la ma thog thung ngu zhes pa snang ba de spyi dang ma mthun gsung 'dug pa/ de ni yi ge bris nor las 'os ma mchis la/ gal te bris nor ma yin na ni/ de'i dgongs pa bskal 475)pa yar 'phel skye 'gro'i gzugs dang tshe bsod thams cad 'phel nas ring du 'gro ba la ring mo'i tha snyad dang*/ mar 'grib kyi skabs de la thams cad thung du 'gro bas thung ngu'i tha snyad du byas pa lta bu yin nam snyam pa 'ol tshod lags te/ gzhan tshe lo'i 'phel 'grib la bzhed pa mi mthun rgyu gang yang ma mchis lags/ yang de skabs kyi 'phros zhor du/ rgya gar ma phyin kun snying lo tsā zhes// bod kyi mkhas btsun thams cad sa mthar 'khyar/ sogs dang*/ nang nag phyi dkar dung dkar snye ma bzhin/ zhes sogs kyi 'phros su/ hor dang yon mchod khrims gsar 'brel ba 'byung*/ zhes yod pa la dpags nas sa skya paṇa chen la lung bstan ngan rtsoms byas par grags 'dug pa ji ltar yin gsung ba/ 'di ni bka' thang du yi ge ma dag pas rkyen byas te blun po 'gas go ba log par 476) bkral ba yin bshad de/ ci'i phyir na/ sa paṇa gyi mtshan la kun dga' rgyal mtshan zhes pa ma gtogs kun dga' snying po mi zhu ba dang*/

sa chen kun snying la ni lo tsār ma grags pa'i phyir dang*/ bod kyi mkhas btsun sa mthar 'khyar ba yang*/ sa hor zung 'jug gi dus der sa skya rang gi bla ma na rim hor dang rgya nag gi bla mchod du byon pa las/ bod kyi mkhas btsun gzhan thams cad ga la byon te/ mdor na 'di skabs kyi tshig 'di gter lung gzhan las kyang 'byung na'ang*/ rgya gar ma phyin kun gyis lo tsā byed// bod kyi mkhas btsun thams cad sa mthar 'khyams/ zhes pa/ bod kyi mkhas btsun dge bshes mang po rang gi chos la nyams len mi byed par lo tsa'i ming btags su byas nas/ rgya gar du ni ma bgrod pas bal yul sogs sa mtha' rnams su 'khyams nas khe grags sgrub pa mang po 'byung bar 477)lung bstan pa dang*/ bod kyi gang zag phyi tshul zhi dul dang chos gzugs bstan kyang nang gi sems rgyud las su mi rung bas phyi dkar nang nag rnams/ sabli ka'am/ dud kha'i snye ma la dpe mdzad pa yin pas/ dkar po rnam gsum sogs la ga nas zer/ dung dkar la snye ma'i sgra sbyar don yang ga la mchis te/ 'di 'dra ba'i rigs sgra log don 'chugs mang pos chud zos su gtong ba mang ngo*/ 'di skabs bzhin lung byang gzhan mang por yang*/ rgyal po'i gdung rabs drug bdun 'das nas bod thams cad lo tsā bar grags pas rgya bal du thags bran pa bzhin rgyugs/ thams cad rang gi che ba 'dod cing chags sdang 'gran sems rlung ltar 'tshub/ rgya gar gyi paṇḍi ta gser 'dod pa dag gis bod na chos gang la dga' ba'i 'dod pa dang bstun nas bcos bslad byed/ sde snod gsum sogs sngags mtshan nyid yongs grags rnams 478)ni da lta bsgyur zin/ rgyud man ngag khyad par can rnams ni o rgyan sogs mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod rnams su bzhugs pas/ skyes chen dam pa grub thob re re tsam min pas mi thon/ rdo rje gdan du ni yud tsam re las tshad pas mi tshugs/ rgya gar shar phyogs dang kha che bal yul rnams su chu ltar myul zhing*/

bsgyur zin rnams la rgyud khungs bcos ma re byas te/ man ngag cung zad re la 'dra min mang du bcos shing rgyud pa gang legs nas 'dren/ bod rnams rmongs la gsar ngas che bas rgyu mtshan ni mi rig rang rang gi lo tsā'i kha 'dzin dang phyogs ris byed cing*/ mdor na mi gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i chos shig la gtso bor byed pa mang po 'byung*/ zhes gsungs/ yang*/ sna thag sas byas hor dmag bod du 'ong*/ zhes pa ni bka' thang gcig pur ma zad gter lung gzhan mang por yang snang ba dang*/ gu ru nyid 479)lho nub tu gshegs pa'i lam zhor du gtsang ri bo glang ru'i mdun du phebs tshe/ sa phyogs 'dir ma 'ongs pa na sa zhes bya ba'i gtsug lag dang*/ 'jam dbyangs kyi sprul pa bdun brgyud kyis sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar bar byed pa 'byung ste/ phung byed hor gyi sna drangs pas/ bod spyi la ni drin du che ba rang mi 'ong*/ zhes gsungs tshul rnam thar phal cher la snang mod lags/ lar yang*/ lung bstan yod tshad o rgyan gyi gsung yin pa'i nges pa mi 'byung tshe/ gter brdzus sogs kyi skyon mthong ba la brten nas gu ru'i gsung lhad med dang gter chos dri med thams cad la log lta dang skur 'debs byas na chos spong gi las chen por 'gyur ba yang shes dgos mod kyi bka' thang na/ de bzhin dus gcig gter gton gnyis mi 'byung*/ zhes dang*/ de'i sgrub byed rgyab skyor du/ gcan gzan rgyal po gang 480)kyi seng ge gcig /'dab chags rgyal po mkha' lding khyung chen gcig /me tog rgyal po u dum wa ra gcig ces sogs mang por bshad snang ba de dag kyang o rgyan gyi gsung du mi bzhed de/ dus gcig la gter gton gnyis tsam du ma zad bzhi lnga tsam/ dus mnyam du byon pa yang byung 'dug pa/ de dag kyang la la ni gcig grogs gcig phan rten 'brel 'grig po yang byung*/ 'ga' zhig ni thugs mi mthun pa chags sdang gi rnam pa byed pa yang byung 'dug pas de rigs la las lung bstan bcos bsgyur byas yod pa yang srid pas na/

rnying ma ba rnams kyis kyang rmongs zhen gcig pus ni chog par mi 'gyur ro/ mdor bsdu na/ chos rgyud gzhan gyi bshes gnyen kun slong gi rang rgyud khengs pa dag gis gsang sngags rnying ma dang rdzogs chen yin no cog chos min du sgrubs pa dang*/ 481)gter ma'i ming thogs tshad sa chos rdo chos 'dre chos zog chos su bsnyad pa dag rnying ma bar khas 'che ba dag kyang rang gi chos kyi go rtogs gtan ma 'jags shing*/ bskyed rdzogs kyi nyams len yid kyi rgud la'ang med bzhin nged cag gsang sngags pa yin zhes/ sha chang bud med dang grong chog la mi tshe lhan gyi skyel ba la rnying ma ba dang o rgyan gu ru'i chos rgyud du rlom pa sogs/ rang gzhan su la bltas kyang bstan pa'i snyigs ma la babs pa'i rang tshul mngon sum du gsal bar gyur pa 'di ni yid pham zhing skyo ba las gzhan pa'i thabs kyis dben mod cing*/ gzhan yang nyid kyis gsungs ba bzhin du/ rang nyid kyis ma go ma shes pa'i rgyab gnon du/ rnam thar gcig na grub thob min zer ba sogs zom 'gros su byed pa mang yang*/ spyir ni sangs rgyas 482)kyi yon tan ba spu'i khung gcig la'ang so so skye bos tshad bzung bar ga la nus shing bsam gyis mi khyab mod/ bye brag tu rnam thar gcig pa ston pa dang mi gcig ston pa yang gdul bya'i skal ba de la gang 'tshams par snang ba las/ mtha' gcig gi ngos bzung ga la rung ste/ ji ltar rgyal ba ma pham pa sku tshad khru brgyad cu sogs su bstan la/ de bzhin gshegs pa skar ma'i rgyal po sku mtshon gang bar bstan pa dang*/ bde gshegs tshe dpag med pa sku tshe lo bye ba 'bum du bzhugs la/ bde gshegs tshogs can gtso bo nyin gcig gi sku tsher snang ba de dag kyang*/ sangs rgyas de dag la phal pa ltar tshe ring thung dang bsod nams che chung yod pa ga la yin kyang*/ gdul bya tha dad kyi skal ngo'i khyad par dag gi mthus de ltar snang mod/

'o skol gyi ston pa la yang thun mong 483)ba dang nyan thos theg dman pa dang byang sems theg chen pa rnams kyis rang rang gi rgyud tshod dang mthun pa'i sku che ba'i yon tan gyi mthong tshul rim pa bzhin mthong la/ lhas byin dang mu stegs pa sogs kyis ni log par rtog pa 'ba' shig las gzhan pa ci yang ma mthong ba de sangs rgyas la yon tan gyi khyad par yod pa min rung*/ gang zag so so'i rang snang yin pa ltar/ slob dpon padma yang skyon bral yon tan kun rdzogs mchog gi sprul pa'i skur byon pa la a 'thas rtag par 'dzin pa'i yul du ma gyur mod kyang*/ gdul bya dang 'dul thabs kyi bye brag las sku mngal skyes dang brdzus skyes kyi 'dod tshul dang*/ rgya gar gyi yul du mtshan dang mdzad pa'i rnam grangs mthun mi mthun ji snyed dang*/ bod yul du yang bzhugs yun 484)ring thung gi khyad par sogs la mtha' gcig tu zhen cing rtsod par byed pa ni ngal ba'i rgyu dang blun pa'i rtags las gzhan mi 'byung phyir bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gnas dang tshul rnams blo'i ra bar shong dgos pa nyid dang*/ nges pa'i snying por slob dpon chen po nyid kyis gsungs pa'i zhal chems rin chen gser 'phreng las/ pad 'byung bdag gis bod kyi don du 'ongs// rdzu 'phrul bkod pas gdug pa ma lus btul// las can mang po smin grol lam la bkod// gter chos zab mos bod khams grub thob bkang*// la lung ri brag sa gzhi rta mig gang*// lus pa med par sgrub gnas byin gyis brlabs// bod khams yun du bde thabs rten 'brel bgyis// sprul pa rgyun chad med pas 'gro ba bskyangs// bod la drin cher byas te drin mi dran/ zhes sogs dang*/ ma 'ongs dus na ma rungs 485)log lta can// bsam med rig bcos can gyi mkhas rlom dang*// rang bstod gzhan la smod pa'i gtam chol 'ga'// padma nga yis bod du yun ma bsdad// la las zla gcig la las zla ba phyed// kha gcig la las bcu yi zhag grangs la// gser gyi rdzongs btab o rgyan log ces
